channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: French Senate rejects assisted dying law
item.description: France's Senate upper house on Wednesday rejected a government-backed draft law on assisted dying that had been billed as one of the country's most important society changes in more than a decade.

item.title: PODCAST: Is France becoming less child-friendly and what's at stake in spring's local elections?
item.description: Welcome back to Talking France - this week's podcast covers the latest news on the French elections, banning children in French trains, fun festivals in February and how to pronounce that tricky French 'R'.

item.title: French expression of the day: Je vais me la péter
item.description: It has nothing to do with farting...

item.title: What happened to France's planned driving license exchange fee?
item.description: You may remember that one of the - many - proposals in France's 2026 budget was to charge foreigners a fee to exchange their driving licence for a French one.

item.title: EU announces new push to overhaul visa system and deportations policy
item.description: The European Union on Thursday laid out plans to overhaul its visa system and step up deportations as part of a five-year migration strategy that cements a hardening line on the hot-button issue.

item.title: France to bring back speed camera 'flashes'
item.description: Speed cameras on French roads will be modified throughout 2026 so that they bring back the 'flash' that lets drivers know they have been caught exceeding the speed limit.

item.title: 5 key things to know about France's speed camera network
item.description: Speed cameras - known as 'radars' - are a political hot topic in France, and some important changes are coming up that drivers need to know about, as Samantha David explains.

item.title: The 8 different speed cameras used on French roads
item.description: From 'teaching' cameras to the multi-function beasts that can issue tickets for eight separate driving offences, France has a wide variety of different speed cameras.

item.title: French island offers up to €10,000 to second-home owners who rent out their property
item.description: Local officials on a French island are offering incentives of up to €10,000 to second-home owners who are willing to rent out their properties on a long-term lease, in order to try and overcome the housing shortage for locals.

item.title: EU announces plan to extend 90-day rule for certain non-EU workers
item.description: The European Commission has announced it will look into allowing certain non-EU professionals to stay in the EU beyond the current 90/180-day rule, as part of a future overhaul of its visa system. It also asked EU countries to make visa access "simpler and faster" for skilled workers.
